footerTermsOfUse.iap:description: Footer link. The conditions somebody agrees to by using the platform — a legal document, so translate the name conservatively rather than idiomatically.

footerUserManual.iap:description: Footer link to the documentation for people using the platform, as opposed to the people running it.

footerFAQ.iap:description: Footer link. An abbreviation of "frequently asked questions", and a language that has no established abbreviation of its own should spell it out rather than keep the English letters.

footerBugReports.iap:description: Footer link. An invitation addressed to the reader, not a heading — an imperative in languages that make the distinction.
